title: Non-leakproof user predicates (LIKE, jsonb @>, lower(), numeric =) under RLS
issue: Security-barrier ordering: a user qual that is not leakproof is evaluated only after the policy quals and cannot become an index condition, so trigram / GIN / expression / numeric indexes are not used.
symptom: For the broad subject (policy lets many rows through) the non-leakproof queries (like_*, jsonb, lower_eq, numeric_eq) are orders of magnitude slower than the baseline, while the leakproof controls (text_eq, id_range) stay fast. Selective subject hides most of the problem.

scale.meaning: rows in app.documents (20 docs per org, so scale/20 orgs and users: the broad subject has scale/40 orgs).
